prompts.connect: bring a question to a table of agents, follow it live, and write its report when it ends
prompts.instructions: roundtables opens a table of agents on a question, through the person's Roundtable 2 engine. The question is the table's whole frame: it is about no part and no project unless you give an Address, which focuses the table on that part. Open one with roundtables_open, giving the question as topic and the seats in speaking order (claude/<model>, codex/<model>, antigravity/<model> or an OpenRouter model id); each seat takes one agent slot. Follow it with roundtables_events after the last seq you read, and chair it with roundtables_comment, hold, continue, advance, reseat and end. Its answer is the host's summary, in roundtables_status. A table exists for its report: when it ends, its record is saved in the project and the person's system agent is asked to write the report from it.
prompts.opening:

What has been learned and kept about this part:
The question:
You can read the project's files in the folder you are in. You cannot change anything, and nothing you say changes the project; the person reads the table's answer and decides. Build on what the others contribute, add what only you can add, and keep going until the question is answered.
prompts.opening_question:
A person brings you a question. It is the whole frame of this discussion: it is not about one part of anything unless it says so, and it may be about something that does not exist yet.
The question:
You are in the folder of the person's project, and you can read its files when the question touches it. You cannot change anything, and nothing you say changes the project; the person reads the table's report and decides. Build on what the others contribute, add what only you can add, and keep going until the question is answered.

prompts.report_request:
Roundtable has ended. It was asked .
Write its report. The table exists for this report: it is how the person takes in what the table did. Read the table's record yourself, not all at once into the conversation: metaform roundtables status gives its answer and state, metaform roundtables events its turns, ideas and rankings, and its whole record with the Borda count; the other files in are the engine's.
The report gives the question; the position each seat took and why; where the seats agreed and where they disagreed; what was decided and what was left open; and the ideas worth acting on, each with where in the project it would live, an Address the map holds or the one it would have. Save it as .
Then tell the person in chat: a link to and a few lines on what the table concluded, not the report itself. An idea the person wants built becomes a ticket with metaform roundtables adopt <idea>, naming the Address where it would live.
